defaultPrompt: Uruchom kontrolowany workflow Intercom → GitHub → weryfikacja dla tego zadania.
Zautomatyzuj tę stronę w trybie fail-closed i zapisz ślady dowodowe.
Przeprowadź audyt istniejącej automatyzacji i wskaż bezpieczne usprawnienia.
interface.longDescription: Executes evidence-gated workflows across Intercom, GitHub, GitHub Codespaces, and other browser-accessible applications. Uses explicit contracts, runtime tool binding, authentication gates, preconditions, postconditions, independent verification, compensating recovery, site-adapter registration, and Codespaces host-image compatibility checks. It fails closed when a required result cannot be verified.

name: deterministic-automation-forge
description: Private execution control-plane for evidence-gated automation across Intercom, GitHub, Codespaces, and browser-operated web applications.
